gaps.description: No unified machine-readable object set exists for events, states, relation classes, propagation channels, cones/horizons, feedback, entropy, irreversibility, projections, diffs, and unmapped residues.
Existing assets do not provide explicit scale-domain and scale-translation fields from quantum/atomic through social, planetary, and cosmological descriptions.
Existing assets contain temporal windows, persistence, irreversibility, and feedback locally but not a shared representation for delay, decay, termination, residual tails, and version diffs.
Foundation gates downgrade causal overclaims, but a derived fabric validator is needed to stop correlation, analogy, light-cone reachability, map adjacency, or path existence from becoming proof.
Function OS can execute specified analysis, but no MCF projector/renderer/validator/diff exists for deterministic use.

non_network_residue: unresolved physics beyond the modeled assumptions
conflicting models that should remain parallel
normative judgment that belongs to Charter Gate rather than causal proof
claim_ceiling: This audit establishes an architectural representation gap only; it does not prove any new causal relation.
